scope: actual current built model/workspace; isolated Map storage and local Mock only

tests.name: an unresolved template configuration cannot be consumed by a new import
an unknown uncommitted template edit blocks new imports until its original failed result is reconciled
already-started runs keep their captured plan while a new template configuration is pending
foreign column names map explicitly to stable actual-category fields and ignored values never enter the record
duplicate target mappings and unchosen columns remain import errors
all required system and custom import fields must be explicitly mapped
changing a mapping invalidates a prior successful preview before any submission
new file, sample and category changes reset prior mapping state
failed file replacement cannot submit the previously confirmed file silently
changed or reordered source headers cannot reuse a prior column mapping
a follow-up or foreign target field cannot be injected into an import mapping
ignored columns cannot hide data beyond the declared source header
ignoring a column never silently drops a nonempty row with missing business identity
legal automatic headers retain their original no-extra-step import path
the latest file read wins even after a newer file has been previewed
pending file reads block preview and import of the previous text
manual text edits cancel a pending read and keep their own confirmed preview
a closed dialog never receives an older read error in a new import dialog
an older read cannot overwrite the error or text of a failed newer read
ordinary operators see import and assignment disabled while their AI batch start remains available
an administrator without import action cannot open the wizard or submit imports
assignment action denial is shared by the toolbar, public dialog and authoritative context
tab-delimited pasted data can contain commas in a customer value
